# GS Hospitality

## About
GS Hospitality is a luxury hospitality and concierge company specialising in servicing delegates attending the Davos Annual Meeting in Davos, Switzerland.

## Services
- Premium accommodation: vetted private chalets, corporate suites, and mountain residences in and around Davos
- Private transfers: dedicated vehicles with professional drivers for airport and intercity travel
- Curated Swiss tours: Glacier Express, Zermatt/Matterhorn, Jungfraujoch, Lake Geneva cruises, St Moritz, and bespoke Alpine itineraries
- VIP concierge: end-to-end logistics, restaurant reservations, event access, and personal assistance throughout your stay

## Location
Davos, Switzerland (Canton of Graubünden)
Serving the Greater Davos area for the Annual Meeting period

## Event Focus
Davos Annual Meeting: 19–23 January 2027

## Contact
Email: hello@gs-hospitality.ch
WhatsApp: available (contact via website)
Response time: within 24 hours; WhatsApp fastest for urgent matters

## Key Differentiators
- Personally vetted properties — every accommodation is inspected and curated
- Local expertise — deep knowledge of Davos, Swiss transport, and the Annual Meeting calendar
- Private vehicles — no shared transfers
- 24-hour response guarantee
- All-inclusive enquiry handling from accommodation through activities

## Pricing
All services are priced on request. No published rates. Enquire at hello@gs-hospitality.ch.
